# Takeflare

> Takeflare is a one-person digital marketing service for owner-run businesses and creators. It sets up and runs the marketing that brings in customers: the Google business profile, a website, Instagram and Facebook, and posts every week. Run by Anton Küppers from Berlin, fully remote, for clients anywhere. Languages: English, German, Russian.

## What Takeflare does

- **Free Google check, €0.** Send the link to your Google business profile to anton@takeflare.com and get five points back by email within two days: name and category, hours and contact details, photos, reviews and replies, website and posts. No call needed.
- **Launch package, €1,249, live in about four weeks.** Business name if a new one is needed, a logo with two rounds of options, the Google business profile set up and filled in, and a phone-first website on the client's own domain. Half up front, half when it's live.
- **Monthly care, €129 a month.** Posts planned and published every week, and the Google profile kept current (hours, photos, prices).
- **Single pieces:** Google business profile €249 (about one week, plus Google's own verification), website €550 (about two weeks), logo €300 (two rounds of options, about two weeks), business name €150 (about one week). Small ad tests on request; the ad budget is paid straight to the platform.
- Prices in euros, fixed and written down before work starts. Outside costs such as printing or booking tools aren't included. No VAT is charged (small business under § 19 UStG).

## How it works

1. Free 20-minute call about the business and the customers it wants more of.
2. A one-page plan: what's worth saying, where, and what it costs. The client says yes, changes it, or walks away.
3. Build: name and logo if needed, then the Google profile, website and social accounts. The client picks from numbered options.
4. Keep it going: weekly posts and an up-to-date Google profile.

## Who it is for

Owner-run local businesses (salons, studios, shops, trades, practices) and creators (authors, musicians) who are good at their work but hard to find online.

## Working together

- The client owns every account: Google profile, domain and social accounts are set up in the client's name.
- One person from the first call to the hundredth post, no account manager in between.
- AI helps with drafts and research; every design and post is picked by a person, then approved by the client.
- The client doesn't have to post or film anything; a few photos of the place and the work help.
